instructions.content:
**Attire**


**Arrival**
Check in with Campus Police office, corner of W 2nd street and Alder Street

**Duties**
Patrol — round every 60 minutes
Route: roving Fire Watch for Recital Hall

this is for fire watch of the Recital Hall

REQUIRED - Fire Watch Record form (see attached image):
The customer requires the CSU Sable Fire Watch Record to be filled out as you go, round by round. Do not wait until the end of your shift to complete it.
- At the start of your shift, fill in Name and Contractor at the top.
- After EVERY round, add a line to the log: Area Patrolled, Date, Time, Comments, and your Initials.
- Write "OK" in Comments when there is no sign of smoke, heat, or fire. Note anything unusual in full.
- Before you leave, sign and date the bottom of the form.
- Emergency contacts: Campus Police +15550000160, or call 911.
